_note: What each battle status says on its card (ui/statuscard.ts). `until` replaces the rounds-left line for a status that doesn't count rounds. The numbers in `desc` are read from RULES in src/game/battle/rules.ts: keep them in step.

sticky.name: Sticky
sticky.desc: Stuck in candy-glass: a little slower, and it can't dodge, curl or bristle. Frost on top freezes it solid.

chilled.name: Chilled
chilled.desc: Acts last in the round. An earth spell shatters the chill for half again the damage.

frozen.name: Frozen
frozen.desc: Frozen solid: it loses its next turn, and can't be frozen again for a while after.

curled.name: Curled up
curled.desc: Rolled into a ball: its defense is more than doubled. An earth spell breaks it open.

bristling.name: Bristling
bristling.desc: Quills out. Hit it with a physical attack and about a third of the blow comes back at you. Spells are safe.
bristling.until: Until it's hit or its next turn

burning.name: Burning
burning.desc: Loses a little health at the end of each round. Fire wears it down, but won't finish it.

hexed.name: Hexed
hexed.desc: Under a hex. Something worse is coming.

cracked.name: Cracked
cracked.desc: Its guard has a crack in it, and blows land harder.

empowered.name: Empowered
empowered.desc: Gathered power: your next damaging spell hits harder.

warded.name: Warded
warded.desc: Your ward is up: blows land much softer, and whoever hits you may be Chilled.

wrapped.name: Wrapped up
wrapped.desc: A wool scarf, wound twice: you can't be Chilled.
wrapped.until: For the rest of this fight
